docs: Case studies content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of cases, each with a picture, the client, the title, the result in one line and an optional address. One object is valid in every cases layout (cards in three or two columns, rows).

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

items.docs: the cases, in the order they are shown

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

image.docs: address of the case picture; none: the placeholder

client.docs: the client or the industry; empty: none

title.docs: the title of the case (the alt text of the picture)

result.docs: the result in one line; empty: none

href.docs: the address of the case page; empty: no link
